facts.text: Data replay feeds recorded real sensor data back into braking software; hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) hardware consists of real-time computing and signal equipment that lets a real control unit run against a simulated machine.

facts.text: Data injection can feed simulated or recorded signals into the sensor path, including raw camera data behind the imager or radar detections, together with recorded J1939 or CAN bus traffic and restbus models of the remaining network.
